Coram : K.G. BALAKRISHNAN*, DALVEER BHANDARI, J.M. PANCHAL
CONSTITUTION OF IND/A, 1950: c Article 317(1) - Chairman, State Public Service Commission - Allegations of 'misbehaviour' against - Reference for inquiry and report whether Chairman, Chattisgarh Public Service Commission ought to be removed - from office on ground of misbehaviour - Held: not define 'misbehaviour' nor does it enumerate what acts would constitute 'misbehaviour' - It is only after a fact ~ finding inquiry is held, it could be said whether alleged acts committed by Chairman amounted to misbehaviour - In the instant case, there is no merit in the allegations - All the
Decision Date : 08-07-2009 | Case No : REF. U/A 317(1) No. 1/2006 | Disposal Nature : Reference answered | Bench : 3 Judges
